training.name: reinforce_llm_10k
training.note: The toy trainer on a pretrained actor: zero-baseline REINFORCE with entropy bonus H/beta, AdamW at torch defaults except lr, no clipping, no warm-up, no evaluator. Learning-rate walk is the toy's shape (constant to 1/4, linear to lr/50 at 5/6, held) at the E2 constants; micro-batches of 64 accumulate the batch-mean gradient; blocks under bfloat16 autocast with float32 master weights and head.
